title: Lab overview
description: Up/down, traffic, errors and latency for every app, plus cluster health.

options.content: Every app at a glance. **Probe**: blackbox check through the ingress (an SSO app passes when it redirects to Authelia). Request rate, 5xx ratio and p95 come from Traefik's per-service metrics (`rules/lab.rules.yaml`). Deeper views: _Apps / HTTP RED_, _Storage_, _Todo_, _Platform_ folder, _Kubernetes_ folder.
